description: Get the full Food Standards Agency FHRS inspection record for one UK establishment by its FHRSID (from uk_food_hygiene_search) — rating, inspection date, sub-scores for hygiene / structural compliance / confidence in management (0 = best, higher = worse), full address, local authority contact, and geocode. Use to check how clean or safe a specific UK restaurant, takeaway, cafe, or pub is. Example: uk_food_hygiene_details({ fhrsid: 537122 })
